'''2015 World Championship''' was the 20th Star Wars CCG World Championship, run by the [[Players Committee]] in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, on 6–9 August 2015.<ref name="pc" /><ref name="awards" /> The constructed format was [[Open]]. 61 players took part.<ref name="pc" /><ref name="wp">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game Star Wars Customizable Card Game], Wikipedia (World Championship table).</ref> [[Justin Desai]] defeated [[Jonny Chu]] in the final, playing Combat Readiness (V) and Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room on Day 3, for his second title after 2013.<ref name="crowned">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/world-champion-crowned-in-philadelphia/ World Champion Crowned in Philadelphia], starwarsccg.org</ref><ref name="awards" /> [[Scott Lingrell]], [[Chris Menzel]] and [[Emil Wallin]] were enshrined in the Players Committee Hall of Fame during the event.<ref name="awards" /> The Players Committee's wrap-up calls the Top 8 stage "Day 2" and the Swiss stage "Day 1"; this page follows the tournament-decklists naming (Day 3 = Top 8, Day 2 = Swiss).<ref name="pc" />

== Results ==

Places 1–2 are from the final.<ref name="crowned" /> The PC decklist page lists [[Matt Sokol]] third and [[Joe Olson]] fourth,<ref name="pc" /> but Olson's 2020 champion article gives him 3rd and Sokol's Hall of Fame biography gives him 4th, so the table follows those. The bracket was not published; the remaining quarterfinalists are shown as 5–8 in Swiss order. Decks are the Day 3 lists.

== Side events ==

=== Hall of Fame ===

[[Scott Lingrell]], [[Chris Menzel]] and [[Emil Wallin]] were enshrined in the Players Committee Hall of Fame on 8 August 2015, during the World Championship.<ref name="awards" />
